Chapter 361 - 361 Wanting to Meet!

361 Wanting to Meet!

In the afternoon, Eagle Country Exhibition Center was as lively as in the morning.

The situation at Flower Stem’s booth was still the same. No one was interested.

Even though Chu Yunyue had already rejected Brewer twice in a row, whenever he had some free time, he would come to look for Chu Yunyue.

“Beautiful Ms. Chu, it seems that no one is visiting your booth. How about we have a few drinks tonight and discuss it?

“I might not have made myself clear yesterday. In fact, before long, I’ll also enter Eagle Country Oil Company and join the ranks of its management. Therefore, you can absolutely believe in my abilities.”

As he said this, he puffed out his chest.

Eagle Country Oil Company was definitely one of the companies with the best benefits in Eagle Country.

Yesterday, he was showing off his background.

Today, he was showing off his future.

He believed that Chu Yunyue would definitely be attracted to him.

…

The continuous harassment made Chu Yunyue completely disgusted.

She frowned and was about to speak.

At this moment, the already lively exhibition center suddenly became extremely noisy, and there were occasional cries of surprise.

“Queen Ibai is here!”

“Queen Ibai has come to the exhibition center to participate in the International Perfume Exhibition!”

“Heavens!”

…

Just as everyone had said, Queen Ibai was indeed here!

At this moment, Queen Ibai, Jules Grant, Riley, and a group of nobles were slowly walking into the exhibition center.

Queen Ibai’s expression did not change much, but her heart was filled with nostalgia.

Due to her health, she rarely left the palace and had never participated in any perfume exhibition.

At this moment, she looked at the various booths and smelled the rich fragrance in the air. Her entire thin face was filled with excitement.

“His name is Lin Fan, but I haven’t seen him yet. If the Queen wishes to see him, I’ll ask him to come over,” Jules Grant said honestly.

“Alright,” Queen Ibai nodded and said.

Even Queen Ibai could not ignore Eagle Country’s Oil Company.

Jules Grant first dialed Lin Fan’s number, but unfortunately, no one picked up.

He had just told the Queen that he would look for the second-largest shareholder.

How could he say now that he could not find him?

What would the queen think of him?

Jules Grant felt helpless as he quickly walked away.

In that case, he would go and find Lin Fan himself.

Jules Grant quickly walked forward and searched for Lin Fan in the crowd.

Luckily, Jules Grant knew that Lin Fan was of Hua Nation nationality. He would stand out among the fair-skinned and dark-skinned people of Eagle Country.

Even so, Jules Grant spent nearly half an hour looking around before he finally saw Flower Stem’s booth. His gaze was locked on a tall, handsome man of Hua descent.

“Mr. Lin!” Jules Grant shouted excitedly.

He shouted and ran toward Flower Stem’s booth.

When Lin Fan heard someone calling him, he turned around slowly.

Although this was a foreign man with a beard, Lin Fan relied on his superb memory to easily identify him from his voice.

Jules Grant had just run over, but before he could say anything, Brewer, who was standing at the side, took the lead and said in an extremely respectful and excited tone, “Hello, Mr. Grant.”

Brewer’s uncle was the director of Eagle Country Oil Company, and he had always wanted to enter Eagle Country Oil Company.

Therefore, he paid more attention to the news and higher-ups of Eagle Country Oil Company compared to the average person.

Brewer did not expect to meet the chairman of Eagle Country Oil Company at the perfume exhibition today.

In his opinion, this was definitely a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

If only he could leave a slight impression on the chairman.

In that case, after some time, when he successfully entered Eagle Country Oil Company, would he not be able to immediately be promoted and make a fortune?

Thinking of this, Brewer felt excited.

Every day, countless people would greet Jules Grant.

Usually, Jules Grant would just nod in response.

He could also just pretend that he did not hear them.

It would be too tiring to answer all of them one by one.

However, when Jules Grant saw that Brewer and Lin Fan were standing together, he thought that he was Lin Fan’s friend.

Thus, he nodded and said, “Hello, hello.”

The chairman of Eagle Country Oil Company had greeted him!

Although it was just a simple reply, it sounded like heavenly music to Brewer’s ears. He was filled with endless joy.

However, Jules Grant did not pay attention to Brewer anymore.

Then, he said to Lin Fan in English in a respectful tone, “Mr. Lin, so you’re here.”

The interpreter beside him translated the words.

Lin Fan said, “I’m the major shareholder of Flower Stem. Of course, I’m here.”

” I see,” Jules Grant said. “Oh right, our Queen Ibai wants to see you.”

“Why does Queen Ibai want to see me?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

In fact, Lin Fan was not the only one who was confused. Chu Yunyue and the others were also confused.

However, before Jules Grant could answer, there was another commotion not far away.

“Greetings, Queen Ibai!”

“Greetings, Queen Ibai!”

Everyone looked in the direction of the voice.

They saw a large group of luxuriously dressed men and women walking over.

The person walking at the front had a head full of hair and a peaceful expression. It was Queen Ibai, who often appeared on television and the news.

Queen Ibai waved her hand gently in response to the greetings from the people around her.

When she turned her head, she happened to see Jules Grant standing in front of Flower Stem’s booth. She could not help but walk forward slowly.

“Lil Jules, you’re here?” Queen Ibai said.

“Yes…” Jules Grant respectfully said. “This is Mr. Lin.”

When Queen Ibai heard this, she could not help but size Lin Fan up. Her kind face revealed a look of surprise.

When she heard Jules Grant introduce Lin Fan’s name, she had already guessed that he was a man from Hua Nation.

However, she did not expect Lin Fan to be so young.

After a while, Queen Ibai said, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan replied, “Queen Ibai, nice to meet you.”

When he said this, his eyes inadvertently fell on Riley, who was standing beside Queen Ibai, and he frowned slightly.
